584	    // MARK: - Rows
585	
586	    /// One schema entry's row. Every `read` answers the default in the
587	    /// binding's `.defaults` mode, so the builders' derived Reset works, and
588	    /// otherwise the binding's mode's value (the selected action's end, its
589	    /// start, the playhead); every write is `InspectorBinding.ops(graphic:…)`
590	    /// over `clips()`.
591	    static func row(
592	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding,
593	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], schema: [String: Any],
594	        assets: @escaping () -> [String]
595	    ) -> NSView {
596	        let key = entry.key, name = "Graphic " + entry.label
597	        func stored() -> GraphicPropValue? {
598	            clips().first.map { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } ?? nil
599	        }
600	        func current() -> GraphicPropValue { stored() ?? entry.default }
601	        func ops(_ value: GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp] {
602	            binding.ops(graphic: value, for: entry, clips: clips(), schema: schema)
603	        }
604	        let mixed = { binding.mixed(clips()) { binding.graphicProps($0)[key] } }
605	        let view: NSView
606	        switch entry.type {
607	        case "number":
608	            let fallback: Double = {
609	                if case .number(let number) = entry.default { return number }
610	                return 0
611	            }()
612	            let bounded = entry.min != nil && entry.max != nil
613	            view = inspectorValueRow(
614	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
615	                decimals: decimals(for: entry),
616	                min: entry.min ?? -1e9, max: entry.max ?? 1e9, slider: bounded,
617	                read: {
618	                    if case .number(let number) = current() { return number }
619	                    return fallback
620	                },
621	                ops: { ops(.number($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
622	        case "boolean":
623	            view = inspectorCheckRow(
624	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
625	                read: {
626	                    if case .bool(let bool) = current() { return bool }
627	                    if case .bool(let bool) = entry.default { return bool }
628	                    return false
629	                },
630	                ops: { ops(.bool($0)) }, mixed: mixed)
631	        case "color":
632	            view = inspectorColorRow(
633	                entry.label, binding, name: name,
634	                read: {
635	                    if case .string(let text)? = stored(), let color = rgba(css: text) {
636	                        return color
637	                    }
638	                    return defaultColor(entry)
639	                },
640	                ops: { ops(.string(css($0))) }, mixed: mixed)
641	        case "enum":
642	            let options = entry.options
643	            view = inspectorPopupRow(
644	                entry.label, binding, name: name, items: options,
645	                read: {
646	                    if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = options.firstIndex(of: text) {
647	                        return index
648	                    }
649	                    if case .string(let text) = entry.default,
650	                       let index = options.firstIndex(of: text)
651	                    {
652	                        return index
653	                    }
654	                    return 0
655	                },
656	                ops: { index in options.indices.contains(index) ? ops(.string(options[index])) : [] },
657	                mixed: mixed)
658	        case "asset":
659	            view = assetRow(entry, binding, name: name, clips: clips, assets: assets,
660	                            current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
661	        case "string":
662	            view = stringRow(entry, binding, name: name, current: current, ops: ops, mixed: mixed)
663	        default:
664	            view = inspectorRow(
665	                entry.label, [inspectorReadout { "type \"\(entry.type)\" is not supported" }])
666	        }
667	        view.toolTip = entry.help
668	        return view
669	    }

671	    /// The asset popup: "None" first on every asset row (G-42 (d)), the
672	    /// folder's files, then any name a clip or the selected action's end
673	    /// holds (or the default names) that the folder does not. A `""`, a
674	    /// `null` or an unknown value reads as "None". "None" writes `null` at
675	    /// the base when the default is `null` and `""` when it is a string; an
676	    /// end takes `""` either way (`endValues`).
677	    private static func assetRow(
678	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding, name: String,
679	        clips: @escaping () -> [ClipSnapshot], assets: @escaping () -> [String],
680	        current: @escaping () -> GraphicPropValue,
681	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
682	    ) -> NSView {
683	        let names = assetNames(
684	            for: entry, files: assets(), clips: clips(),
685	            end: binding.selectedAction?.end.graphic?.props ?? [:])
686	        let items = ["None"] + names
687	        let offset = 1
688	        return inspectorPopupRow(
689	            entry.label, binding, name: name, items: items,
690	            read: {
691	                if case .string(let text) = current(), let index = names.firstIndex(of: text) {
692	                    return index + offset
693	                }
694	                return 0
695	            },
696	            ops: { index in
697	                if index == 0 { return ops(entry.default == .null ? .null : .string("")) }
698	                let at = index - offset
699	                return names.indices.contains(at) ? ops(.string(names[at])) : []
700	            },
701	            mixed: mixed)
702	    }

705	    /// `OptionFieldControl` is numeric, so the row is assembled here with an
706	    /// explicit default rather than through `inspectorValueRow`.

708	        _ entry: GraphicSchemaEntry, _ binding: InspectorBinding, name: String,
709	        current: @escaping () -> GraphicPropValue,
710	        ops: @escaping (GraphicPropValue) -> [ReelOp], mixed: @escaping () -> Bool
711	    ) -> NSView {

713	            if case .string(let text) = current() { return text }
714	            return ""
715	        }

717	        let control: NSView = entry.multiline
718	            ? InspectorTextArea(
719	                read: read, write: { [weak binding] in binding?.apply(name, write($0)) },
720	                enabled: { true }, onEdit: { [weak binding] in binding?.edited() })

723	                enabled: { true }, onEdit: { [weak binding] in binding?.edited() })
724	        // Either control takes the row's width (`inspectorRow`, spec §11 G-48).
725	        return inspectorRow(
726	            entry.label, [control], mixed: mixed, binding: binding, writes: write(read()),
727	            discrete: true, default: .derived(binding, name: name, read: read, ops: write))

1	// app/Sources/GraphicPackage.swift — the Graphic dialog's Export… and
2	// `export_graphic` (spec §11 G-46): one graphic written as a `.fjgraphic`
3	// package holding its module and only the project fonts and assets the
4	// engine saw it use.
5	//
6	// **A job is built on main and written off it.** `GraphicPackageJob.project`
7	// and `.template` read the document on main: the module's bytes, its title,
8	// category and description (`GraphicCatalog`), its size and length
9	// (`AgentServer.metaWhole`, as `render_graphic` reads them), and a FRESH
10	// library (`GraphicStore.makeIndexedLibrary()`; a template's holds the
11	// bundled faces alone). `write(to:)` runs QuickJS, so it runs only on the
12	// sheet's 8 MiB `Thread` or the agent's server thread — never main, never GCD.
13	//
14	// **The usage rule** (G-46 (b)): the module is compiled against that library
15	// and drawn — every frame up to `maxFrames` with its default props, else
16	// `maxFrames` evenly spaced, each `svg` then `rasterize` — and then each
17	// variant (an `enum` option other than the default, a boolean's opposite, in
18	// schema order, at most `maxVariants`) over `variantFrames` evenly spaced
19	// frames, every other prop at its default. The library's `usage()` is then
20	// every project font blob and asset to pack; a bundled face never is. A
21	// frame that throws is skipped and counted.
22	//
23	// **The file** is the core's (`ReelGraphicPackage.write`): written as
24	// `.<file>.partial` beside the destination and renamed over it, so an
25	// existing file is replaced whole; any throw removes the partial file.
26	
27	import Foundation
28	import UniformTypeIdentifiers
29	
30	enum GraphicPackage {
31	    static let fileExtension = "fjgraphic", typeIdentifier = "com.kgalligan.framejob-graphic"
32	    static let maxFrames = 900, variantFrames = 30, maxVariants = 32
33	
34	    /// The exported type (`project.yml`), else data by its extension (spec §11 G-47 (g)).
35	    static var contentType: UTType {
36	        UTType(typeIdentifier)
37	            ?? UTType(filenameExtension: fileExtension, conformingTo: .data) ?? .data
38	    }
39	
40	    /// The manifest's `app_version`: the bundle's `CFBundleShortVersionString`, else "".
41	    static var appVersion: String {
42	        Bundle.main.object(forInfoDictionaryKey: "CFBundleShortVersionString") as? String ?? ""
43	    }
44	
45	    /// Every frame of `length` when there are at most `cap`, else `cap` frames evenly spaced
46	    /// from the first to the last.
47	    static func sampledFrames(length: Int, cap: Int) -> [Int] {
48	        guard length > cap else { return Array(0..<max(length, 0)) }
49	        guard cap > 1 else { return cap == 1 ? [0] : [] }
50	        return (0..<cap).map { i in
51	            Int((Double(i) * Double(length - 1) / Double(cap - 1)).rounded())
52	        }
53	    }
54	
55	    /// The props of each variant G-46 (b) draws: one per `enum` option other than its
56	    /// default and one per boolean's opposite, in schema order, at most `maxVariants`.
57	    static func variants(_ schema: GraphicSchema) -> [[String: Any]] {
58	        var out: [[String: Any]] = []
59	        for entry in schema.entries {
60	            switch (entry.type, entry.default) {
61	            case ("enum", let value):
62	                let current: String? = { if case .string(let s) = value { return s }; return nil }()
63	                for option in entry.options where option != current {
64	                    out.append([entry.key: option])
65	                }
66	            case ("boolean", .bool(let flag)):
67	                out.append([entry.key: !flag])
68	            default:
69	                continue
70	            }
71	        }
72	        return Array(out.prefix(maxVariants))
73	    }
74	}

76	/// What one export wrote.
77	struct GraphicPackageResult {
78	    let url: URL
79	    /// The manifest's in-package paths, in order; `manifest.json` itself is not among them.
80	    let files: [String]
81	    /// Every frame drawn (the defaults' and the variants'), and how many of them threw.
82	    let frames: Int
83	    let failedFrames: Int
84	}

86	/// One graphic, read off the document on main, ready to be written off it.
87	struct GraphicPackageJob {
88	    let name: String
89	    /// What a compile failure names: `graphics/<name>.js` or `the template "<name>"`.
90	    let label: String
91	    let title: String
92	    let category: String
93	    let description: String?
94	    let source: Data
95	    let library: GraphicLibrary
96	    /// The library's font blobs: the project file each came from, nil for a bundled face.
97	    let fonts: [GraphicFile?]
98	    let assets: [GraphicFile]
99	    let width: Int
100	    let height: Int
101	    let length: Int
102	    let fps: Fps
103	    let canvas: CanvasSnapshot
104	    let appVersion: String
105	
106	    /// A This Project module, read on main. Throws the store's sentence when the folder does
107	    /// not hold it.
108	    static func project(named name: String, document: ProjectDocument) throws -> GraphicPackageJob {
109	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else {
110	            throw ReelCoreError(message: ProjectDocument.noGraphicsFolderSentence)
111	        }
112	        let indexed = try store.makeIndexedLibrary()
113	        guard let file = indexed.scan.modules[name] else {
114	            throw ReelCoreError(message: store.noModuleSentence(name))
115	        }
116	        var meta: [String: Any] = [:]
117	        if case .compiled(_, _, let described, _)? = GraphicRegistry.shared.entry(
118	            named: name, for: document.recipeKey)
119	        {
120	            meta = described
121	        }
122	        return try make(
123	            name: name, label: "graphics/\(name).js", meta: meta, source: file.bytes,
124	            library: indexed.library, fonts: indexed.fonts, assets: indexed.scan.assets,
125	            document: document)
126	    }
127	
128	    /// A bundled template, read on main, with a library of the bundled faces alone.
129	    static func template(
130	        _ entry: GraphicTemplateLibrary.Entry, document: ProjectDocument
131	    ) throws -> GraphicPackageJob {
132	        let name = entry.template.name
133	        let source: Data
134	        do {
135	            source = try Data(contentsOf: entry.template.url)
136	        } catch {
137	            throw ReelCoreError(
138	                message: "\(entry.template.url.path) could not be read: "
139	                    + error.localizedDescription)
140	        }
141	        let library = GraphicLibrary()
142	        var fonts: [GraphicFile?] = []
143	        for url in GraphicStore.bundledFontURLs(in: ProjectDocument.bundledFontsDirectory) {
144	            try library.addFont(Data(contentsOf: url))
145	            fonts.append(nil)
146	        }
147	        var meta: [String: Any] = [:]
148	        if case .compiled(_, _, let described, _) = entry.entry { meta = described }
149	        return try make(
150	            name: name, label: "the template \"\(name)\"", meta: meta, source: source,
151	            library: library, fonts: fonts, assets: [], document: document)
152	    }
153	
154	    private static func make(
155	        name: String, label: String, meta: [String: Any], source: Data, library: GraphicLibrary,
156	        fonts: [GraphicFile?], assets: [GraphicFile], document: ProjectDocument
157	    ) throws -> GraphicPackageJob {
158	        let canvas = document.project.snapshot.canvas
159	        let tick = max(canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
160	        let width: Int, height: Int, length: Int
161	        do {
162	            width = try AgentServer.metaWhole(meta, "width", name, in: AgentServer.sides)
163	                ?? canvas.width
164	            height = try AgentServer.metaWhole(meta, "height", name, in: AgentServer.sides)
165	                ?? canvas.height
166	            length = try AgentServer.metaWhole(
167	                meta, "durationInFrames", name, in: 1...Int.max / Int(tick))
168	                ?? Int((5 * canvas.fps.double).rounded(.up))
169	        } catch let error as AgentServer.ToolError {
170	            throw ReelCoreError(message: error.message)
171	        }
172	        return GraphicPackageJob(
173	            name: name, label: label, title: GraphicCatalog.title(meta: meta, name: name),
174	            category: GraphicCatalog.category(meta: meta),
175	            description: GraphicCatalog.description(meta: meta), source: source,
176	            library: library, fonts: fonts, assets: assets, width: width, height: height,
177	            length: length, fps: canvas.fps, canvas: canvas, appVersion: GraphicPackage.appVersion)
178	    }
179	
180	    /// Compiles, draws by G-46 (b)'s rule, and writes the package at `url`, replacing a file
181	    /// there. Never on main and never on GCD: the sheet's 8 MiB `Thread` or the agent's server
182	    /// thread. Throws a sentence, writing nothing, for a module that does not compile.
183	    func write(to url: URL) throws -> GraphicPackageResult {
184	        let module: GraphicModule
185	        do {
186	            module = try GraphicModule.compile(
187	                library: library, name: name, source: String(decoding: source, as: UTF8.self),
188	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.offlineBudgetMs)
189	        } catch {
190	            let first = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error).first
191	            let line = first?.line.map { " (line \($0))" } ?? ""
192	            throw ReelCoreError(
193	                message: "\(label) does not compile: " + (first?.message ?? "no diagnostic")
194	                    + line)
195	        }
196	        let describe = module.describeJSON()
197	        let described = (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(describe.utf8)))
198	            as? [String: Any]
199	        let schema = GraphicSchema(
200	            describeJSON: describe, schema: described?["schema"] as? [String: Any] ?? [:])
201	        var frames = 0, failed = 0
202	        let sample = { (frame: Int, props: [String: Any]) in
203	            frames += 1
204	            if !self.draw(module, frame: frame, props: props) { failed += 1 }
205	        }
206	        for frame in GraphicPackage.sampledFrames(length: length, cap: GraphicPackage.maxFrames) {
207	            sample(frame, [:])
208	        }
209	        let variantFrames = GraphicPackage.sampledFrames(
210	            length: length, cap: GraphicPackage.variantFrames)
211	        for props in GraphicPackage.variants(schema) {
212	            for frame in variantFrames { sample(frame, props) }
213	        }
214	
215	        let usage = library.usage()
216	        let usedFonts = usage.fonts.compactMap { fonts.indices.contains($0) ? fonts[$0] : nil }
217	        let usedAssets = usage.assets.compactMap { used in assets.first { $0.name == used } }
218	        var listed: [[String: Any]] = [["path": "\(name).js", "size": source.count]]
219	        var data = source
220	        for (folder, files) in [
221	            (GraphicStore.fontsFolderName, usedFonts), (GraphicStore.assetsFolderName, usedAssets),
222	        ] {
223	            for file in files {
224	                listed.append(["path": "\(folder)/\(file.name)", "size": file.bytes.count])
225	                data.append(file.bytes)
226	            }
227	        }
228	        let spec: [String: Any] = [
229	            "module": name, "title": title, "category": category,
230	            "description": description ?? NSNull(), "app_version": appVersion, "files": listed,
231	        ]
232	        let specJSON = String(
233	            decoding: try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: spec), as: UTF8.self)
234	
235	        let partial = url.deletingLastPathComponent()
236	            .appendingPathComponent(".\(url.lastPathComponent).partial")
237	        let manifest: String
238	        do {
239	            manifest = try ReelGraphicPackage.write(
240	                path: partial.path, packageJSON: specJSON, data: data)
241	            guard rename(partial.path, url.path) == 0 else {
242	                let why = String(cString: strerror(errno))
243	                throw ReelCoreError(message: "\(url.path) could not be replaced: \(why)")
244	            }
245	        } catch {
246	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: partial)
247	            throw error
248	        }
249	        let parsed = (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(manifest.utf8)))
250	            as? [String: Any]
251	        let paths = (parsed?["files"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? [])
252	            .compactMap { $0["path"] as? String }
253	        return GraphicPackageResult(url: url, files: paths, frames: frames, failedFrames: failed)
254	    }
255	
256	    /// One frame drawn and rasterized at the graphic's size; false when either threw.
257	    private func draw(_ module: GraphicModule, frame: Int, props: [String: Any]) -> Bool {
258	        let ctx = AgentServer.graphicContext(
259	            frame: frame, fps: fps, length: length, width: width, height: height, canvas: canvas)
260	        guard let ctxData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ctx),
261	            let propsData = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: props)
262	        else { return false }
263	        do {
264	            let drawn = try module.svg(
265	                frame: frame, propsJSON: String(decoding: propsData, as: UTF8.self),
266	                ctxJSON: String(decoding: ctxData, as: UTF8.self),
267	                budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.offlineBudgetMs)
268	            _ = try library.rasterize(drawn.svg, width: width, height: height)
269	            return true
270	        } catch {
271	            return false
272	        }
273	    }
274	}
275	// app/Sources/GraphicPackageImport.swift — a `.fjgraphic` copied into a
276	// project's `graphics/` (spec §11 G-47): what the package holds, where each
277	// file goes, the copy, and what it answers. No UI: the sheet
278	// (`GraphicImportSheetController.swift`) and `import_graphic`
279	// (`AgentServer+GraphicImports.swift`) both call these bodies, so the two
280	// doors refuse in the same sentences.
281	//
282	// **The checks** (G-47 (c)) are the core's first — `ReelGraphicPackage.read`,
283	// the archive and its manifest — then the app's: a font must load in a
284	// throwaway library, as `importFont` does, and an asset must be a name
285	// `asset(name)` can use. Every refusal is "<file name> cannot be imported:
286	// <sentence>", and none writes anything.
287	//
288	// **The plan** (G-47 (d)) puts each file under the manifest's name: written
289	// when the name is free, reused when the file there holds the same bytes;
290	// otherwise a module or a font takes `-2`, `-3`, … and an asset refuses the
291	// import, because the module reaches it by name. A name is matched exactly:
292	// one that differs only in case is another file, and is never free.
293	//
294	// **The copy** (G-47 (e)) writes the fonts, then the assets, with
295	// `landNew` (never replacing), then the module with `write(name:bytes:)`; a
296	// throw removes every file it wrote, rescans and rethrows. One `rescan()` at
297	// the end, from the caller's handler or command — never from a
298	// `.graphicsDidChange` observer. Not undoable and never dirty (G-3).
299	
300	import Foundation
301	
302	/// One font or asset of a package, under the manifest's `name`.
303	struct GraphicPackageFile {
304	    let name: String
305	    let bytes: Data
306	}
307	
308	/// A package read and checked, ready to plan.
309	struct GraphicPackageContents {
310	    let module: String
311	    let title: String
312	    let category: String
313	    let description: String?
314	    let appVersion: String
315	    let source: Data
316	    let fonts: [GraphicPackageFile]
317	    let assets: [GraphicPackageFile]
318	
319	    /// Reads the file at `url` and checks it, the core's checks then the app's.
320	    static func read(at url: URL) throws -> GraphicPackageContents {
321	        let refuse = { (sentence: String) in
322	            ReelCoreError(message: "\(url.lastPathComponent) cannot be imported: \(sentence)")
323	        }
324	        let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .fileSizeKey])
325	        guard values?.isRegularFile == true else { throw refuse("it is not a file") }
326	        let size = values?.fileSize ?? 0
327	        guard size > 0 else { throw refuse("it is empty (0 bytes)") }
328	        guard UInt64(size) <= UInt64(UInt32.max) else {
329	            throw refuse("it is \(size) bytes, more than a .fjgraphic holds (\(UInt32.max))")
330	        }
331	        let data: Data
332	        do {
333	            data = try Data(contentsOf: url)
334	        } catch {
335	            throw refuse("it could not be read: \(error.localizedDescription)")
336	        }
337	        let answer: String
338	        do {
339	            answer = try ReelGraphicPackage.read(data)
340	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
341	            throw refuse(error.message)
342	        }
343	        guard let manifest = (try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(answer.utf8)))
344	            as? [String: Any], let files = manifest["files"] as? [[String: Any]],
345	            let first = files.first
346	        else { throw refuse("the core's answer could not be read") }
347	        func bytes(_ file: [String: Any]) -> Data {
348	            let offset = file["offset"] as? Int ?? 0, length = file["size"] as? Int ?? 0
349	            return data.subdata(in: offset..<(offset + length))
350	        }
351	        var fonts: [GraphicPackageFile] = [], assets: [GraphicPackageFile] = []
352	        for file in files.dropFirst() {
353	            let entry = GraphicPackageFile(name: file["name"] as? String ?? "", bytes: bytes(file))
354	            let path = file["path"] as? String ?? ""
355	            if path.hasPrefix(GraphicStore.fontsFolderName + "/") {
356	                fonts.append(entry)
357	            } else {
358	                assets.append(entry)
359	            }
360	        }
361	        for font in fonts {
362	            let ext = (font.name as NSString).pathExtension.lowercased()
363	            guard GraphicStore.fontExtensions.contains(ext) else {
364	                throw refuse("the font \"\(font.name)\" is not a .ttf or .otf file")
365	            }
366	            do {
367	                try GraphicLibrary().addFont(font.bytes)
368	            } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
369	                throw refuse("the font \"\(font.name)\": \(error.message)")
370	            }
371	        }
372	        for asset in assets {
373	            let ext = (asset.name as NSString).pathExtension.lowercased()
374	            guard GraphicStore.assetExtensions.contains(ext) else {
375	                throw refuse(
376	                    "the picture \"\(asset.name)\" is not a \(GraphicStore.assetKinds) file")
377	            }
378	            guard GraphicAssetName.isLegal(asset.name) else {
379	                throw refuse("the picture \"\(asset.name)\" \(GraphicAssetName.rule)")
380	            }
381	            guard !asset.bytes.isEmpty else {
382	                throw refuse("the picture \"\(asset.name)\" is empty (0 bytes)")
383	            }
384	        }
385	        return GraphicPackageContents(
386	            module: manifest["module"] as? String ?? "", title: manifest["title"] as? String ?? "",
387	            category: manifest["category"] as? String ?? "",
388	            description: manifest["description"] as? String,
389	            appVersion: manifest["app_version"] as? String ?? "", source: bytes(first),
390	            fonts: fonts, assets: assets)
391	    }
392	}
393	
394	/// What an import does with one file.
395	enum GraphicImportAction: String {
396	    case written, reused
397	}
398	
399	/// One file's place: `name` the manifest's, `target` the name on disk.
400	struct GraphicImportPlacement {
401	    let name: String
402	    let target: String
403	    let action: GraphicImportAction
404	}
405	
406	/// Where every file of a package goes in one project, and the copy.
407	struct GraphicImportPlan {
408	    let contents: GraphicPackageContents
409	    let module: GraphicImportPlacement
410	    let fonts: [GraphicImportPlacement]
411	    let assets: [GraphicImportPlacement]
412	
413	    /// G-47 (d) over the store's scan and the disk. Throws, writing nothing, for an asset
414	    /// whose name holds a different picture, or with no store.
415	    static func make(_ contents: GraphicPackageContents, document: ProjectDocument) throws
416	        -> GraphicImportPlan
417	    {
418	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else {
419	            throw ReelCoreError(message: ProjectDocument.noGraphicsFolderSentence)
420	        }
421	        let folder = store.folderURL
422	        let free = { (name: String) in
423	            !store.holdsModule(named: name) && document.graphicClips(named: name).isEmpty
424	        }
425	        let module: GraphicImportPlacement
426	        let held = try? Data(contentsOf: folder.appendingPathComponent(contents.module + ".js"))
427	        if free(contents.module) {
428	            module = .init(name: contents.module, target: contents.module, action: .written)
429	        } else if held == contents.source {
430	            module = .init(name: contents.module, target: contents.module, action: .reused)
431	        } else {
432	            let root = String(String.UnicodeScalarView(contents.module.unicodeScalars.prefix(60)))
433	            var n = 2
434	            while !free("\(root)-\(n)") { n += 1 }
435	            module = .init(name: contents.module, target: "\(root)-\(n)", action: .written)
436	        }
437	        var fonts = Names(folder.appendingPathComponent(GraphicStore.fontsFolderName))
438	        let fontPlaces = contents.fonts.map { font -> GraphicImportPlacement in
439	            var target = font.name
440	            var n = 2
441	            while true {
442	                if let action = fonts.place(target, font.bytes) {
443	                    return .init(name: font.name, target: target, action: action)
444	                }
445	                target = GraphicAssetName.withSuffix(font.name, n)
446	                n += 1
447	            }
448	        }
449	        var assets = Names(folder.appendingPathComponent(GraphicStore.assetsFolderName))
450	        let assetPlaces = try contents.assets.map { asset -> GraphicImportPlacement in
451	            guard let action = assets.place(asset.name, asset.bytes) else {
452	                throw ReelCoreError(
453	                    message: "graphics/assets/\(asset.name) already holds a different picture, "
454	                        + "and this graphic reaches its own by asset(\"\(asset.name)\"), so it "
455	                        + "cannot be renamed; rename or remove the project's file and import "
456	                        + "again")
457	            }
458	            return .init(name: asset.name, target: asset.name, action: action)
459	        }
460	        return GraphicImportPlan(
461	            contents: contents, module: module, fonts: fontPlaces, assets: assetPlaces)
462	    }
463	
464	    /// One folder's names, as the disk holds them and as this plan claims them.
465	    private struct Names {
466	        let folder: URL
467	        var taken: [String]
468	
469	        init(_ folder: URL) {
470	            self.folder = folder
471	            taken = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: folder.path)) ?? []
472	        }
473	
474	        /// `.written` when `name` is free (and claims it), `.reused` when a file of exactly
475	        /// that name holds `bytes`, nil otherwise — a name that differs only in case is taken.
476	        mutating func place(_ name: String, _ bytes: Data) -> GraphicImportAction? {
477	            let url = folder.appendingPathComponent(name)
478	            if taken.contains(name) {
479	                return (try? Data(contentsOf: url)) == bytes ? .reused : nil
480	            }
481	            let folded = name.lowercased()
482	            guard !taken.contains(where: { $0.lowercased() == folded }),
483	                !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path)
484	            else { return nil }
485	            taken.append(name)
486	            return .written
487	        }
488	    }
489	
490	    /// The copy: fonts, assets, then the module, none replacing a file; a throw removes what
491	    /// it wrote and rescans. One `rescan()` at the end. Main.
492	    func apply(to store: GraphicStore) throws {
493	        var written: [URL] = []
494	        var current = ""
495	        do {
496	            try store.ensureFolder()
497	            for (folder, places, files) in [
498	                (GraphicStore.fontsFolderName, fonts, contents.fonts),
499	                (GraphicStore.assetsFolderName, assets, contents.assets),
500	            ] {
501	                for (place, file) in zip(places, files) where place.action == .written {
502	                    current = "\(folder)/\(place.target)"
503	                    written.append(try store.landNew(file.bytes, into: folder, as: place.target))
504	                }
505	            }

560	// app/Sources/GraphicStore+History.swift — the kept revisions of a
561	// document's modules and the rename journal (spec §11 G-27, G-28, G-29).
562	//
563	// **On disk**, inside `graphics/`:
564	// `history/<name>/<%06d sequence>-<revision>.js` is one kept text — the next
565	// sequence is the highest plus one, and any other file there is ignored —
566	// and `history/renames.json` is a JSON array of `[a, b]` pairs (the app
567	// moved the file FROM `a` TO `b`; the repair only ever moves it back, G-28
568	// (e)), oldest first, at most `renameJournalLimit`, a repeated unordered
569	// pair moved to the end. Both are user content carried by every save (spec
570	// §5.6), never a cache.
571	//
572	// **`history/` is created only inside an existing `graphics/`** (G-14:
573	// `ensureFolder()` stays the one creator of the folder), with no
574	// `packageContentsDidChangeOnDisk()` call — `fonts/`'s precedent in
575	// `GraphicStore+Import.swift`.
576	//
577	// **History never holds the current text.** `keepReplaced`, which a pass
578	// calls on the store's queue before it stores its scan, keeps the bytes a
579	// module's new text replaced and drops the new text's own revision; a
580	// text kept twice is listed once, and the lowest sequences past
581	// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing is kept at `start()`, for a removal
582	// the app did not make, or for a text that came and went inside one pass;
583	// `start()` DROPS each module's current revision from its history (a text
584	// put back while the project was closed), which is a drop and not a keep.
585	//
586	// **A file-less name with kept revisions is a DELETED module** (G-27 (f);
587	// a rename killed part-way leaves the same state: G-28 (f)): `moveHistory`
588	// leaves no `history/<from>/` behind, which is what makes that test sound
589	// for `ProjectDocument.reconcileGraphicNames()`.
590	
591	import CryptoKit
592	import Foundation
593	
594	/// One kept text of a module: its revision (G-13), its place in the
595	/// module's history and its file.
596	struct GraphicKept: Equatable {
597	    let revision: String, sequence: Int, url: URL
598	}
599	
600	extension GraphicStore {
601	    static let historyFolderName = "history", renameJournalName = "renames.json"
602	    static let historyLimit = 10, renameJournalLimit = 32
603	
604	    // MARK: - Reading (main)
605	
606	    /// The kept texts of `name`, newest first, read from the disk; empty
607	    /// for a name that is not a module name.
608	    func kept(named name: String) -> [GraphicKept] {
609	        Array(Self.keptEntries(named: name, in: folderURL).reversed())
610	    }
611	
612	    /// The names holding at least one kept text, sorted — deleted modules
613	    /// included.
614	    func keptNames() -> [String] {
615	        let history = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(Self.historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
616	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: history.path)) ?? []
617	        return names.filter { !Self.keptEntries(named: $0, in: folderURL).isEmpty }.sorted()
618	    }
619	
620	    /// The journalled renames, newest first.
621	    func renamePairs() -> [(String, String)] {
622	        Self.journal(in: folderURL).reversed().map { ($0[0], $0[1]) }
623	    }
624	
625	    // MARK: - Writing (the store's queue, or main inside `onQueue`)
626	
627	    /// Keeps `bytes` as the newest text of `name`: an entry already holding
628	    /// that revision is removed first, then the lowest sequences past
629	    /// `historyLimit` are pruned. Nothing unless `folder` exists.
630	    static func keep(_ bytes: Data, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
631	        let files = FileManager.default
632	        guard isModuleName(name), files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
633	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
634	        try? files.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
635	        let revision = hex(SHA256.hash(data: bytes))
636	        let entries = keptEntries(named: name, in: folder)
637	        let next = (entries.last?.sequence ?? 0) + 1
638	        do {
639	            try bytes.write(
640	                to: directory.appendingPathComponent(entryName(next, revision)), options: .atomic)
641	        } catch {
642	            return
643	        }
644	        tidy(name, in: folder)
645	    }
646	
647	    /// Removes every kept entry of `name` holding `revision`.
648	    static func dropKept(revision: String, named name: String, in folder: URL) {
649	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder) where entry.revision == revision {
650	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: entry.url)
651	        }
652	        removeIfEmpty(historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder))
653	    }
654	
655	    /// One pass's history work, file work only: for every name in BOTH
656	    /// scans whose revision differs, the old scan's bytes are kept; for
657	    /// every name whose revision is new or changed, the current revision is
658	    /// dropped from its history.
659	    static func keepReplaced(from last: GraphicScan, to found: GraphicScan, in folder: URL) {
660	        for (name, module) in found.modules.sorted(by: { $0.key < $1.key }) {
661	            let old = last.modules[name]
662	            guard old?.revision != module.revision else { continue }
663	            if let old = old { keep(old.bytes, named: name, in: folder) }
664	            dropKept(revision: module.revision, named: name, in: folder)
665	        }
666	    }
667	
668	    /// `from`'s entries appended, in order, after `to`'s highest sequence,
669	    /// then pruned; `history/<from>/` is gone afterwards. A throw leaves
670	    /// both histories as they were.
671	    static func moveHistory(from: String, to: String, in folder: URL) throws {
672	        let files = FileManager.default
673	        let source = historyDirectory(of: from, in: folder)
674	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: source.path) else { return }
675	        let target = historyDirectory(of: to, in: folder)
676	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: target.path) else {
677	            try files.moveItem(at: source, to: target)
678	            return
679	        }
680	        var sequence = keptEntries(named: to, in: folder).last?.sequence ?? 0
681	        var moved: [(from: URL, to: URL)] = []
682	        do {
683	            for entry in keptEntries(named: from, in: folder) {
684	                sequence += 1
685	                let landed = target.appendingPathComponent(entryName(sequence, entry.revision))
686	                try files.moveItem(at: entry.url, to: landed)
687	                moved.append((entry.url, landed))
688	            }
689	            try files.removeItem(at: source)
690	        } catch {
691	            for pair in moved.reversed() { try? files.moveItem(at: pair.to, to: pair.from) }
692	            throw error
693	        }
694	        tidy(to, in: folder)
695	    }
696	
697	    /// Journals a rename: the pair appended, an earlier entry of the same
698	    /// unordered pair removed, the oldest dropped past `renameJournalLimit`.
699	    /// Nothing unless `folder` exists.
700	    static func recordRename(_ a: String, _ b: String, in folder: URL) {
701	        let files = FileManager.default
702	        guard files.fileExists(atPath: folder.path) else { return }
703	        var pairs = journal(in: folder).filter { Set($0) != Set([a, b]) }
704	        pairs.append([a, b])
705	        pairs = Array(pairs.suffix(renameJournalLimit))
706	        let history = folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
707	        try? files.createDirectory(at: history, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
708	        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: pairs) else { return }
709	        try? data.write(to: renameJournalURL(in: folder), options: .atomic)
710	    }
711	
712	    /// `history/renames.json` as it is on disk: its bytes, or nil when
713	    /// there is no file.
714	    static func renameJournalBytes(in folder: URL) -> Data? {
715	        try? Data(contentsOf: renameJournalURL(in: folder))
716	    }
717	
718	    /// Puts the journal back as `renameJournalBytes` read it: those bytes,
719	    /// or no file — what a rename refused after its pair was written does,
720	    /// at the fold (`moveModule`) or at the clips (`renameGraphic`'s move
721	    /// back), so a refused act journals nothing (G-28 (d)).
722	    static func putBackRenameJournal(_ bytes: Data?, in folder: URL) {
723	        let url = renameJournalURL(in: folder)
724	        if let bytes = bytes {
725	            try? bytes.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
726	        } else {
727	            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)
728	        }
729	    }
730	
731	    // MARK: - The files
732	
733	    private static func renameJournalURL(in folder: URL) -> URL {
734	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
735	            .appendingPathComponent(renameJournalName)
736	    }
737	
738	    /// `history/<name>/` inside `folder`.
739	    static func historyDirectory(of name: String, in folder: URL) -> URL {
740	        folder.appendingPathComponent(historyFolderName, isDirectory: true)
741	            .appendingPathComponent(name, isDirectory: true)
742	    }
743	
744	    private static func entryName(_ sequence: Int, _ revision: String) -> String {
745	        String(format: "%06d", sequence) + "-" + revision + ".js"
746	    }
747	
748	    /// The kept entries of `name`, oldest first: every
749	    /// `<sequence>-<64 hex digits>.js` in its directory.
750	    private static func keptEntries(named name: String, in folder: URL) -> [GraphicKept] {
751	        guard isModuleName(name) else { return [] }
752	        let directory = historyDirectory(of: name, in: folder)
753	        let names = (try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path)) ?? []
754	        var entries: [GraphicKept] = []
755	        for file in names where file.hasSuffix(".js") {
756	            let parts = file.dropLast(3).split(separator: "-", omittingEmptySubsequences: false)
757	            guard parts.count == 2, let sequence = Int(parts[0]), sequence > 0,
758	                parts[1].count == 64, parts[1].allSatisfy({ "0123456789abcdef".contains($0) })
759	            else { continue }
760	            entries.append(GraphicKept(
761	                revision: String(parts[1]), sequence: sequence,
762	                url: directory.appendingPathComponent(file)))
763	        }
764	        return entries.sorted { $0.sequence < $1.sequence }
765	    }
766	
767	    /// One revision once (its highest sequence), then at most
768	    /// `historyLimit` entries, the lowest sequences removed.
769	    private static func tidy(_ name: String, in folder: URL) {
770	        let files = FileManager.default
771	        var seen = Set<String>()
772	        var newestFirst: [GraphicKept] = []
773	        for entry in keptEntries(named: name, in: folder).reversed() {
774	            if seen.insert(entry.revision).inserted {
775	                newestFirst.append(entry)
776	            } else {
777	                try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url)
778	            }
779	        }
780	        for entry in newestFirst.dropFirst(historyLimit) { try? files.removeItem(at: entry.url) }
781	    }
782	
783	    private static func removeIfEmpty(_ directory: URL) {
784	        let files = FileManager.default
785	        guard let names = try? files.contentsOfDirectory(atPath: directory.path), names.isEmpty
786	        else { return }
787	        try? files.removeItem(at: directory)
788	    }
789	
790	    /// The journal as written: every element that is a pair of strings.
791	    private static func journal(in folder: URL) -> [[String]] {
792	        guard let data = renameJournalBytes(in: folder),
793	            let pairs = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [Any]
794	        else { return [] }
795	        return pairs.compactMap { $0 as? [String] }.filter { $0.count == 2 }
796	    }
797	}
798	// app/Sources/GraphicStore+Import.swift — a font or a picture copied into
799	// `graphics/fonts/` or `graphics/assets/` (road map 10 §5h, G4b; G5b): the
800	// ONE body behind the agent's `import_graphic_font` and
801	// `import_graphic_asset` and a person's File ▸ Add Font to Graphics… and
802	// Add Image to Graphics…, so the two doors refuse in the same sentences.
803	//
804	// It goes through `ensureFolder()`, the ONE creator of `graphics/` inside a
805	// package (G-14), and lands the file the way `write(name:source:)` lands a
806	// module: a `<name>.partial` beside it, then moved into place, so the scan
807	// never reads half a file (a `.partial`'s extension is in neither the font
808	// nor the asset set, so it is never listed). `importFile` does not rescan;
809	// `importFont` and `importAsset` end in ONE `rescan()`, so the registry has
810	// its new library when they return — both are called from a handler or a
811	// command, never from a `.graphicsDidChange` observer (`drain()` is not
812	// re-entrant).
813	//
814	// **A font's family names are the ENGINE's own** (`rc_graphic_library_families`):
815	// the file is loaded into a throwaway library of its own and that library is
816	// asked, so `families` is exactly what a `font-family` must say — CoreText
817	// names some files differently (road map 10 §10.7 G4b measured 13 of 2500).
818	// Not undoable and never dirty (G-3).
819	//
820	// **An asset's name is one `asset(name)` can use** (spec §11 G-23): a name
821	// that is not is legalised (`GraphicAssetName`) and the copy filed under it,
822	// taking `-2`, `-3`, … while that name is held (scan or disk), so a RENAMED
823	// copy never replaces; the answer says the name used and the name asked for.
824	//
825	// **`landNew` is the `.fjgraphic` import's write** (spec §11 G-47 (e)): bytes
826	// already read, landed the same way but NEVER replacing — a file already at
827	// the name is a throw — and no rescan, which the import does once at its end.
828	
829	import Foundation
830	
831	extension GraphicStore {
832	    /// Copies `source` to `graphics/<subfolder>/<name>`, replacing a file of
833	    /// that name. Whether one was replaced. Main.
834	    func importFile(from source: URL, into subfolder: String, as name: String) throws
835	        -> (url: URL, replaced: Bool)
836	    {
837	        try ensureFolder()
838	        let files = FileManager.default
839	        let folder = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(subfolder, isDirectory: true)
840	        try files.createDirectory(at: folder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
841	        let target = folder.appendingPathComponent(name)
842	        let replaced = try Self.land(at: target) { try files.copyItem(at: source, to: $0) }
843	        return (target, replaced)

846	    /// `bytes` written to `graphics/<subfolder>/<name>` through a `.partial` beside it, never
847	    /// replacing: throws when a file is already there. Does not rescan. Main.
848	    func landNew(_ bytes: Data, into subfolder: String, as name: String) throws -> URL {
849	        try ensureFolder()
850	        let files = FileManager.default
851	        let folder = folderURL.appendingPathComponent(subfolder, isDirectory: true)
852	        try files.createDirectory(at: folder, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
853	        let target = folder.appendingPathComponent(name)
854	        guard !files.fileExists(atPath: target.path) else {
855	            throw ReelCoreError(message: "graphics/\(subfolder)/\(name) already exists")
856	        }
857	        let partial = folder.appendingPathComponent(name + ".partial")
858	        try? files.removeItem(at: partial)
859	        do {
860	            try bytes.write(to: partial)
861	            // `moveItem` refuses an existing target, so a file that appeared meanwhile stays.
862	            try files.moveItem(at: partial, to: target)
863	        } catch {
864	            try? files.removeItem(at: partial)
865	            throw error
866	        }
867	        return target
868	    }

871	    static let assetKinds = "PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG or SVGZ"

873	    /// A `.ttf` or `.otf` copied into `graphics/fonts/` under its own name,
874	    /// then `rescan()`. The families are the engine's reading of that file
875	    /// alone. Main.
876	    func importFont(from source: URL) throws -> (url: URL, replaced: Bool, families: [String]) {
877	        let path = source.path
878	        guard Self.fontExtensions.contains(source.pathExtension.lowercased()) else {
879	            throw ReelCoreError(message: "\(path) is not a .ttf or .otf file")
880	        }
881	        let bytes: Data
882	        do {
883	            bytes = try Data(contentsOf: source)
884	        } catch {
885	            throw ReelCoreError(
886	                message: "\(path) could not be read: \(error.localizedDescription)")
887	        }
888	        let probe = GraphicLibrary()
889	        do {
890	            try probe.addFont(bytes)
891	        } catch let error as ReelCoreError {
892	            throw ReelCoreError(message: "\(path): " + error.message)
893	        }
894	        let families = probe.families()
895	        let landed = try importNamed(source, Self.fontsFolderName, source.lastPathComponent)
896	        rescan()
897	        return (landed.url, landed.replaced, families)
898	    }

900	    /// A picture copied into `graphics/assets/<name>`, then `rescan()`.
901	    /// `name` is what `asset(name)` says; its extension must be one of the
902	    /// six. A name `asset(name)` cannot use is filed under a legal one
903	    /// (`renamedFrom` is the name asked for), never replacing a file. Main.
904	    func importAsset(from source: URL, as name: String) throws
905	        -> (url: URL, name: String, replaced: Bool, bytes: Int, renamedFrom: String?)
906	    {
907	        let path = source.path
908	        let kinds = Self.assetKinds
909	        guard !name.isEmpty, !name.contains("/") else {
910	            throw ReelCoreError(
911	                message: "name must be a file name with no / (got \"\(name)\") — it is what "
912	                    + "asset(name) says")
913	        }
914	        guard Self.assetExtensions.contains((name as NSString).pathExtension.lowercased())
915	        else {
916	            throw ReelCoreError(
917	                message: "\(name) is not a \(kinds) file (.png .jpg .jpeg .gif .webp .svg .svgz)")
918	        }
919	        let size = (try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: source.path)[.size]
920	            as? NSNumber)?.intValue ?? 0
921	        // An empty file crosses the FFI as NULL and the scan skips it.
922	        guard size > 0 else {
923	            throw ReelCoreError(
924	                message: "\(path) is empty (0 bytes) — an asset must hold a \(kinds) image")
925	        }
926	        let legal = GraphicAssetName.legalized(name)
927	        var used = legal
928	        if legal != name {
929	            var n = 2
930	            while holdsAsset(named: used) {
931	                used = GraphicAssetName.withSuffix(legal, n)
932	                n += 1
933	            }
934	        }
935	        let landed = try importNamed(source, Self.assetsFolderName, used)
936	        rescan()
937	        return (landed.url, used, landed.replaced, size, used == name ? nil : name)
938	    }

940	    /// True when the scan lists `name` or `graphics/assets/<name>` is on disk.
941	    func holdsAsset(named name: String) -> Bool {
942	        scan.assets.contains { $0.name == name }
943	            || FileManager.default.fileExists(
944	                atPath: folderURL.appendingPathComponent(Self.assetsFolderName, isDirectory: true)
945	                    .appendingPathComponent(name).path)
946	    }

948	    /// `importFile`, its failure said in a sentence naming the folder.
949	    private func importNamed(_ source: URL, _ subfolder: String, _ name: String) throws
950	        -> (url: URL, replaced: Bool)
951	    {
952	        do {
953	            return try importFile(from: source, into: subfolder, as: name)
954	        } catch {
955	            throw ReelCoreError(
956	                message: "graphics/\(subfolder)/\(name) could not be written: "
957	                    + error.localizedDescription)
958	        }
959	    }
960	}

977	    let modified: Date

980	    /// The file's identity, or nil when its attributes cannot be read.

983	            let size = (attributes[.size] as? NSNumber)?.uint64Value,

985	            let fileNumber = (attributes[.systemFileNumber] as? NSNumber)?.uint64Value

988	        self.modified = modified
989	        self.fileNumber = fileNumber

1001	    /// Queue only. Answers the accepted fonts and the refusal warnings in `urls` order;

1004	        var fonts: [GraphicFile] = []

379	            let canvas = document.project.snapshot.canvas

384	                ?? Self.metaWhole(compiled.meta, "height", name, in: Self.sides) ?? canvas.height

396	        }

398	        var cells: [GraphicSheetCell] = []
399	        for frame in frames {

401	                frame: frame, fps: context.fps, length: context.frames, width: context.width,
402	                height: context.height, canvas: context.canvas)
403	            let drawn: (svg: String, warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic])
404	            do {

412	                }
413	                reports.append(
414	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics))
415	                cells.append(Self.cardCell(name, frame, diagnostics))
416	                continue
417	            }
418	            if format == "svg" {
419	                return try svgReply(name, frame, drawn.svg, drawn.warnings, ctx)
420	            }
421	            if !drawn.warnings.isEmpty {
422	                reports.append(
423	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: drawn.warnings))
424	            }
425	            do {

444	            let sheet = GraphicContactSheet.paint(cells, layout: layout, background: background)

452	        } catch {

//! [`GraphicProps`], what a graphic clip is drawn from, and the checks
//! every writer of one shares: the module name rule (G-3), the side bound,

302	// 10 §5h, G4b): a module drawn WITHOUT a clip, as a contact sheet of up to
303	// sixteen frames with each frame number printed under its cell, or as one
304	// frame's SVG text.
305	//
306	// **Runs on the SERVER thread** (`AgentServer.offMainTools`), `render_frame`'s
307	// posture: sixteen 4K frames are seconds of work, and freezing the UI for them
308	// is not acceptable. Every document touch is inside one `onMain` — the
309	// target, the module as the registry compiled it, the canvas — and the draw
310	// after it is the engine's, which is any-thread (`GraphicModule.svg`,
311	// `GraphicLibrary.rasterize`). The module is held for the whole call, and it
312	// holds its library strongly, so a rescan mid-call swaps the registry's set
313	// and not this one.
314	//
315	// **The ctx is the clip's, with no clip** (`recipe_graphic.rs`'s keys
316	// exactly): the canvas's fps, `durationInFrames` from `meta` (else 5 s at
317	// that rate, ceiled), the module's size from the caller, else `meta`, else
318	// the canvas — `add_graphic_clip`'s defaults — and the project's canvas.
319	// A frame that throws or will not rasterize is its error card on the sheet
320	// and a sentence in the reply; a warning is a sentence too.
321	//

323	// non-null `path`, `background` or `max_width` — the png sheet's — is refused
324	// by name, before the multi-frame refusal, since svg answers text and writes
325	// no file. A frame at or past `durationInFrames` is DRAWN, not refused, with
326	// `progress` clamped at 1: a clip longer than its length draws those frames
327	// too (G-9, G-19 (b)). A png sheet past `GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels`
328	// of frames is refused once the size is known, before any frame is drawn
329	// or any file written (G-20 (d)).
330	import Foundation
331	extension AgentServer {
332	    /// `render_graphic` — UI path: none — the preview well is a person's
333	    /// picture; §5j builds no strip.
334	    func renderGraphic(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
335	        let name = try requiredString(a, "name")
336	        let frames = try graphicFrames(a)
337	        let propsJSON = try graphicPropsJSON(a)
338	        let requestedWidth = try graphicSide(a, "width")
339	        let requestedHeight = try graphicSide(a, "height")
340	        let format = try stringArg(a, "format") ?? "png"
341	        guard format == "png" || format == "svg" else {
342	            throw ToolError(message: "format must be png or svg (got \"\(format)\").")
343	        }
344	        if format == "svg" {
345	            let sheetOnly = ["path", "background", "max_width"].filter {
346	                a[$0].map { !($0 is NSNull) } ?? false
347	            }
348	            if !sheetOnly.isEmpty {
349	                throw ToolError(
350	                    message: "format svg takes no path, background or max_width — those are the "
351	                        + "png contact sheet's; svg answers one frame's SVG text in the reply and "
352	                        + "writes no file (got \(sheetOnly.joined(separator: ", "))).")
353	            }
354	            if frames.count > 1 {
355	                throw ToolError(
356	                    message: "format svg answers ONE frame's SVG, and frames names "
357	                        + "\(frames.count); ask for one frame, or for a png contact sheet.")
358	            }
359	        }
360	        let maxWidth = try intArg(a, "max_width") ?? GraphicContactSheet.maxWidthDefault
361	        let widths = GraphicContactSheet.maxWidthMin...GraphicContactSheet.maxSide
362	        guard widths.contains(maxWidth) else {
363	            throw ToolError(
364	                message: "max_width must be \(widths.lowerBound)…\(widths.upperBound) px "
365	                    + "(got \(maxWidth)).")
366	        }
367	        let backgroundName = try stringArg(a, "background") ?? "transparent"
368	        guard let background = GraphicSheetBackground(backgroundName) else {
369	            throw ToolError(
370	                message: "background must be \(GraphicSheetBackground.accepted) "
371	                    + "(got \"\(backgroundName)\").")
372	        }
373	        let url = format == "png" ? try graphicSheetDestination(a, name: name) : nil
374	        let context = try onMain {
375	            () throws -> (module: GraphicModule, width: Int, height: Int, fps: Fps,
376	                canvas: CanvasSnapshot, frames: Int) in
377	            let document = try self.target(a)
378	            let compiled = try self.compiledModule(named: name, document)
379	            let canvas = document.project.snapshot.canvas
380	            let tick = max(canvas.fps.frameDuration, 1)
381	            let width = try requestedWidth.map(Int.init)
382	                ?? Self.metaWhole(compiled.meta, "width", name, in: Self.sides) ?? canvas.width
383	            let height = try requestedHeight.map(Int.init)
384	                ?? Self.metaWhole(compiled.meta, "height", name, in: Self.sides) ?? canvas.height
385	            let length = try Self.metaWhole(
386	                compiled.meta, "durationInFrames", name, in: 1...Int.max / Int(tick))
387	                ?? Int((5 * canvas.fps.double).rounded(.up))
388	            return (compiled.module, width, height, canvas.fps, canvas, length)
389	        }
390	        let pixels = frames.count * context.width * context.height
391	        if format == "png", pixels > GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels {
392	            throw ToolError(
393	                message: "A contact sheet draws at most \(GraphicContactSheet.maxCellPixels) px of "
394	                    + "frames; \(frames.count) frame(s) of \(context.width)×\(context.height) are "
395	                    + "\(pixels) px — ask for fewer frames or a smaller width and height.")
396	        }
397	        var reports: [GraphicReport] = []
398	        var cells: [GraphicSheetCell] = []
399	        for frame in frames {
400	            let ctx = Self.graphicContext(
401	                frame: frame, fps: context.fps, length: context.frames, width: context.width,
402	                height: context.height, canvas: context.canvas)
403	            let drawn: (svg: String, warnings: [GraphicDiagnostic])
404	            do {
405	                drawn = try context.module.svg(
406	                    frame: frame, propsJSON: propsJSON, ctxJSON: Self.jsonText(ctx),
407	                    budgetMs: GraphicRegistry.offlineBudgetMs)
408	            } catch {
409	                let diagnostics = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
410	                if format == "svg" {
411	                    return try svgReply(name, frame, nil, diagnostics, ctx)
412	                }
413	                reports.append(
414	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics))
415	                cells.append(Self.cardCell(name, frame, diagnostics))
416	                continue
417	            }
418	            if format == "svg" {
419	                return try svgReply(name, frame, drawn.svg, drawn.warnings, ctx)
420	            }
421	            if !drawn.warnings.isEmpty {
422	                reports.append(
423	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: drawn.warnings))
424	            }
425	            do {
426	                let raster = try context.module.library.rasterize(
427	                    drawn.svg, width: context.width, height: context.height)
428	                if !raster.warnings.isEmpty {
429	                    reports.append(GraphicReport(
430	                        name: name, frame: frame, failed: false, diagnostics: raster.warnings))
431	                }
432	                cells.append(GraphicSheetCell(frame: frame, image: raster.cgImage(), cardText: nil))
433	            } catch {
434	                let diagnostics = GraphicDiagnostic.of(error)
435	                reports.append(
436	                    GraphicReport(name: name, frame: frame, failed: true, diagnostics: diagnostics))
437	                cells.append(Self.cardCell(name, frame, diagnostics))
438	            }
439	        }
440	        let layout = GraphicContactSheet.layout(
441	            count: cells.count, cellWidth: context.width, cellHeight: context.height,
442	            maxWidth: maxWidth)
443	        guard let url = url,
444	            let sheet = GraphicContactSheet.paint(cells, layout: layout, background: background)
445	        else {
446	            throw ToolError(
447	                message: "The contact sheet of \(layout.width)×\(layout.height) px could not be "
448	                    + "painted.")
449	        }
450	        do {
451	            try FrameWriter.write(sheet, as: .png, to: url)
452	        } catch {
453	            throw ToolError(message: error.localizedDescription)
454	        }
455	        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else {
456	            throw ToolError(message: "Wrote \(url.path) but could not read it back.")
457	        }
458	        let listed = frames.map(String.init).joined(separator: ", ")
459	        var text = "Contact sheet of \(frames.count) frame(s) of \"\(name)\" — frames \(listed) — "
460	            + "each \(context.width)×\(context.height) px at scale "
461	            + String(format: "%g", layout.scale)
462	            + " on \(layout.columns)×\(layout.rows), \(layout.width)×\(layout.height) px, "
463	            + "background \(backgroundName)."
464	        for report in reports {
465	            text += " " + Self.graphicSentence(report)
466	        }
467	        text += " Written to \(url.path)."
468	        return try callResult(
469	            content: [
470	                ["type": "image", "data": data.base64EncodedString(), "mimeType": "image/png"],
471	                ["type": "text", "text": text],
472	            ], isError: false)
473	    }
474	    /// `frames` (1…16 whole numbers ≥ 0) or `frame`, never both; `[0]` for
475	    /// neither.
476	    private func graphicFrames(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> [Int] {
477	        let single = try intArg(a, "frame")
478	        let listed = a["frames"].flatMap { $0 is NSNull ? nil : $0 }
479	        if single != nil, listed != nil {
480	            throw ToolError(message: "frame and frames are exclusive — pass one or the other.")
481	        }
482	        if let single = single {
483	            guard single >= 0 else { throw ToolError(message: "frame must be 0 or more: \(single).") }
484	            return [single]
485	        }
486	        guard let listed = listed else { return [0] }
487	        let limit = GraphicContactSheet.maxFrames
488	        guard let list = listed as? [Any], (1...limit).contains(list.count) else {
489	            throw ToolError(message: "frames must be a list of 1 to \(limit) frame numbers.")
490	        }
491	        return try list.enumerated().map { index, raw in
492	            guard let number = raw as? NSNumber, CFGetTypeID(number) != CFBooleanGetTypeID(),
493	                let whole = AgentServer.whole(number), whole >= 0
494	            else {
495	                throw ToolError(
496	                    message: "frames[\(index)] must be a whole frame number of 0 or more "
497	                        + "(got \(AgentServer.describe(raw))).")
498	            }
499	            return whole
500	        }
501	    }
502	    /// `props` as the JSON text the engine takes; `{}` when absent.
503	    private func graphicPropsJSON(_ a: [String: Any]) throws -> String {
504	        guard let raw = a["props"], !(raw is NSNull) else { return "{}" }
505	        guard let props = raw as? [String: Any] else {
506	            throw ToolError(message: "props must be an object keyed by the schema's names")
507	        }
508	        return Self.jsonText(props)
509	    }
510	    /// Where the sheet is written: `path` through `destinationURL` as a
511	    /// `.png`, its folder required to exist; else a temporary file.
512	    private func graphicSheetDestination(_ a: [String: Any], name: String) throws -> URL {
513	        guard let path = try stringArg(a, "path") else {
514	            return Self.temporaryOutput("framejob-graphic-\(name)", extension: "png")
515	        }
516	        return try Self.requireFolder(
517	            of: Self.destinationURL(try Self.nonEmptyOutputPath(path), extension: "png"))
518	    }
519	    /// `recipe_graphic.rs`'s ctx for `frame` of a `length`-frame graphic.
520	    static func graphicContext(
521	        frame: Int, fps: Fps, length: Int, width: Int, height: Int, canvas: CanvasSnapshot
522	    ) -> [String: Any] {
523	        let rate = fps.double
524	        let progress = min(max(Double(frame) / Double(max(length - 1, 1)), 0), 1)
525	        return [
526	            "fps": rate, "time": rate > 0 ? Double(frame) / rate : 0,
527	            "durationInFrames": length, "progress": progress,
528	            "width": width, "height": height,
529	            "canvas": ["width": canvas.width, "height": canvas.height],
530	        ]
531	    }
532	    /// The `svg` format's answer: one frame's text, or why there is none.
533	    private func svgReply(
534	        _ name: String, _ frame: Int, _ svg: String?, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic],
535	        _ ctx: [String: Any]
536	    ) throws -> String {
537	        try jsonResult([
538	            "name": name, "frame": frame, "ok": svg != nil, "svg": svg ?? NSNull(),
539	            "diagnostics": diagnostics.map(Self.diagnosticJSON), "ctx": ctx,
540	        ])
541	    }
542	    private static func cardCell(
543	        _ name: String, _ frame: Int, _ diagnostics: [GraphicDiagnostic]
544	    ) -> GraphicSheetCell {
545	        GraphicSheetCell(
546	            frame: frame, image: nil,
547	            cardText: LayerRenderers.errorCardText(
548	                name: name, frame: frame, diagnostic: diagnostics.first))
549	    }
550	    private static func jsonText(_ object: [String: Any]) -> String {
551	        guard let data = try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: object) else { return "{}" }
552	        return String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)
553	    }
554	}

//! [`GraphicProps`], what a graphic clip is drawn from, and the checks
//! every writer of one shares: the module name rule (G-3), the side bound,

//!

//! The core never reads the module (it has no filesystem), so the schema a

- **G-9 — A graphic has its own timeline: `in` and `length`, and `split`
  pins it** (road map 10 §4, 2026-09-25; built by G2b). `graphic.in`
  (ticks, ≥ 0) is where on the graphic's own timeline the clip's first
  frame falls; `graphic.length` (ticks, or `null`) is how long that
  timeline is, and `null` means "it ends with the clip", which is what a
  fresh clip wants: stretch the clip and the animation stretches its outro
  to the new end. `split` gives the right half `in + cut` and pins BOTH
  halves' `length` to the original's effective length, so the animation
  continues across the cut and plays its outro once, at the true end.
  `trim_start` advances `in` and `trim_end` never changes `length`, so
  trimming a graphic cuts it as trimming media cuts a file. There is no
  source bound: a clip longer than `length` keeps calling `render` with
  frames past `durationInFrames`, and what it draws there is the module's
  business. The core computes the frame: `frame = floor((in + clip time) /
  frame_ticks)` on the canvas grid and `ctx.durationInFrames =
  ceil(effective length / frame_ticks)`, clip time being §7.3's, which
  already accounts for nests. A graphic has no `speed`. Three decisions
  G2b made building it (road map 10 §10.5):
  - **G-9·a — no head bound, and `roll` is a front trim.** The head clamp
    (`source_window.rs`'s `earliest_start_on_grid`) stays media-only and
    answers nothing for a graphic, so a graphic's start can be dragged or
    rolled to 0 and `in` saturates at 0 through `in_advanced` at speed 1.
    `roll` moves `in` on the clip whose start it moves, as `trim_start`
    does (its predecessor's end is an end trim and keeps `length`), because
    it is the crate's other front-trim writer and has no source guard.
    `in` and `length` are written only by `recipe_graphic.rs`'s
    `graphic_advanced` (from `trim_start`, `roll` and `split`'s second
    half) and the split pin; `set_graphic` refuses `in`.
  - **G-9·b — the layer's hash covers `ctx`.** It is `content_hash` over
    `{name, frame, ctx, props}` — everything `render` is called with — not
    over name, props, size and frame alone: at one frame a `trim_end`
    changes `durationInFrames` and so the outro, and a rate change changes
    `time`, and a narrower key would serve a stale texture, the defect
    `recipe_text.rs` folds `reveal` in to prevent. The module's revision is
    the app's to add (G-13).
  - **G-9·c — a `null` length is `in + duration`, not `duration`.** "It
    ends with the clip" places the graphic's timeline end at the clip's
    end, which is graphic time `in + duration`. With `duration` alone a
    `trim_start` to 1 s on a fresh 5 s clip would give `durationInFrames`
    120 while the clip's last frame is graphic frame 149 — the outro would
    finish a second early and then hold — and split-then-delete-the-head,
    which looks the same, would give 150. Under this rule a front trim or
    a roll leaves `durationInFrames` where it was, and the split pin writes
    the number the unsplit clip already had.
- **G-15 — The Graphic sub-tab: what it shows for several clips, and what a
  write sends** (road map 10 §10.9 G5a, 2026-09-25).
  (a) **Several clips.** The sub-tab exists when EVERY selected clip is a
  graphic clip. Source and Size always show; Properties shows only when
  every clip is drawn by ONE module, because that is the one schema rows can
  be built from and the one `set_graphic` checks against; Timeline shows
  only for one clip, because `in` and `length` are that clip's own. With
  clips of different modules, Source names them and says to select one
  module's clips.
  (b) **A value equal to the schema's default is written as `null`.** The
  key leaves the stored props and the module draws its own default, which
  is what Reset writes too (CI-9), so "differs from the default" and "is
  stored" agree. A colour is equal by its parsed channels (the core accepts
  any string as a colour default and normalises only stored values). A
  default the four hex forms cannot parse (a named colour, `rgb()`) shows
  as transparent black, and its Reset writes `null`. (Amended by G-34 (l):
  with an action selected a row writes the value itself into the action's
  end, never `null`.)
  (c) **Stale keys are listed sorted by key** — the stored props reach the
  app as a dictionary, which has no order. ⌫ writes `{key: null}` with no
  schema; a `null` always removes (G-4).
  (d) **The diagnostics are checked at the clip's FIRST frame**, drawn and
  rasterized at the clip's own size (the paused frame's two calls), memoised
  by module, revision, library, frame hash and size, and never recomputed
  during a live gesture.
  (e) **A string prop is a one-line text field, or a text area when
  `multiline`**, not §5j's value row: `OptionFieldControl` is numeric.
  (f) **No preview strip.** `render_graphic` has no inspector control; a
  person looks at the preview well.
- **G-16 — Insert ▸ Graphic: where the clip goes, what the module is
  called, and what a module that does not compile does** (road map 10
  §10.9 G5b, 2026-09-25). Insert ▸ Graphic is `write_graphic` of a template
  or a chosen `.js`, then `add_graphic_clip` at the module's `meta`
  duration and size, as ONE undo step "Insert Graphic" (the file write is
  not undoable, G-3).
  (a) **Placement is Add Text's** (`addGeneratedClip`, §4.1 "at the
  playhead"): the front track if the clip fits there, else a new track
  above everything. So no track, or a playhead over a clip, never disables
  the item; it validates on the document's graphics store alone.
  (b) **The name is the file's stem made a module name, then made free**:
  lowercased, every run of anything but `a-z0-9` one `-`, trimmed, at most
  63 (`graphic` when nothing is left) — `My Counter (v2).js` is
  `my-counter-v2` — then `GraphicStore.uniqueModuleName`: the name when
  the folder holds no module of it, else `-2`, `-3`, …, so an insert never
  overwrites a module another clip draws. Duplicate as New Graphic…'s
  suggestion uses the same rule.
  (c) **A module that does not compile stays on disk and places nothing**:
  the person reads "graphics/<name>.js was written but does not compile:
  <the first diagnostic> (line N)" in a sheet, and can fix the file where
- **G-18 — A graphic's own timeline moves with a transition's head and
  crosses a frame grid; a graphic clip with no description is tolerated**
  (issue #72, 2026-09-29).
  (a) **`add_transition`'s handle form moves `in` back by the head
  extension** through `graphic_advanced`, its fourth writer. G-9·a stands —
  no head bound — so where `in` is less than the extension it saturates at
  0 and the graphic's first frame lands on the clip's new first frame:
  `trim_start`'s answer at 0, and the one step 9 gives a text reveal.
  (b) **`graphic.in` is not a source position in D7-3's sense**: the
  graphic's frames are the canvas's (G-9's `floor((in + clip time) /
  frame)`). So every re-snap through `frame_grid.rs` (`set_canvas` fps,
  both paste paths, `unnest`) snaps `in` to the nearest frame, ≥ 0, and a
  set `length` to the nearest frame with `set_graphic`'s one-frame floor. A
  null length stays null.
  (c) **Declined: `validate` keeps accepting a `Source::Graphic` clip with
  no `graphic`.** The recipe answers `missing`, and the app draws the slate
  it draws for missing media. `set_graphic` answers `clip N is not a
  graphic clip`, so the clip is deleted rather than repaired. Refusing
  would make a whole document unreadable over a clip that holds nothing,
  which is `validate`'s canvas posture (model_query.rs:205-208).

  `a_file_with_a_bad_module_name_is_refused_and_an_absent_description_is_not`
